decisions.decision: DueResult gains explicit odoIsStale and baselineIsGuess flags; isEstimate becomes their OR (P3-D-01)
decisions.rationale: computeDue currently collapses two causes into one flag while HOME-05 needs three renderings with two different action buttons. Keeping the split in pure Dart honours 5.3 (widgets never compute item status) and puts it under due_test.dart.

decisions.decision: Home shows a card when daysLeft <= 30, everything else collapses into one row (P3-D-02)
decisions.rationale: Matches 11.1's mockup exactly (2 cards over 9 collapsed = 11, P2-D-01's scooter count). status != ok cannot produce it because leadDays defaults to 7. Decoupling from leadDays stops a notification-lead change reshaping the home screen.

decisions.decision: The collapsed row expands inline via ExpansionTile; expanded rows navigate to item detail (P3-D-03)
decisions.rationale: A separate all-items list would be an eighth screen against D-33; tappable rows are what keeps LOG-05 reachable for a healthy item.

decisions.decision: The header prefixes km with ~ whenever estimateOdo(vehicle) > vehicle.currentOdoKm (P3-D-04)
decisions.rationale: HOME-02's literal 'whenever isEstimate' would print 44 days of drift as a measured figure, the opposite of 9.5. The tilde now disappears on save and returns as drift accrues.

decisions.decision: One log sheet covers several items; the source item is pre-ticked and ticking reveals per-item brand/spec/cost (P3-D-05)
decisions.rationale: Reconciles LOG-01's multi-item entry with 8.4's single-item mockup: the one-item case stays seconds of work, and one workshop visit is one entry.

decisions.decision: Cost is entered per item; totalCostVnd is the read-only auto-sum (P3-D-06)
decisions.rationale: A total-only sheet leaves entry.costVnd null, silently failing LOG-02's lastCostVnd clause and losing the price history that makes the next log fast.

decisions.decision: resetsCycle is a two-state toggle inside each ticked item, defaulting to 'Da thay' (P3-D-07)
decisions.rationale: LOG-02 explicitly requires the inspection-without-replacement case; keeping the toggle next to the item avoids a second navigation layer in an already-long modal.

decisions.decision: addServiceLog also moves the vehicle odometer and runs refineAvgDailyKm, taking the same path as addOdoReading (P3-D-08)
decisions.rationale: A deliberate hardening over 5.2's literal listing, which appends OdoReading(source: service) but leaves Vehicle untouched. Under the source as written, a user who logs 'today, 18.420 km' returns to a home screen still reading ~18.665 km / cap nhat 40 ngay, and the most valuable measurement the app can get is discarded.

decisions.decision: The self-drawn keypad appends digits at the end and backspaces from the end, over the prefilled estimate (P3-D-09)
decisions.rationale: 11.2's stated intent is 'chi can sua vai chu so'. A calculator-style clear-on-first-keypress makes the prefill useless, and a 12-cell grid has no cursor to move.

decisions.decision: 'Lower than last time' is checked against vehicle.currentOdoKm (P3-D-10)
decisions.rationale: currentOdoKm is the last real reading and always exists; latestReadingFor() returns null right after onboarding. Checking against estimateOdo() would block correct entries because the estimate routinely runs ahead.

Onboarding currently creates no reading, so the first ODO update hits refineAvgDailyKm's prevReading == null branch and the P2-D-07 band seed survives an extra cycle. Closes the hole at the head of the history P2-D-10 reads from and ends OdoSource.setup being dead. Modifies a Phase 2 function -- a named deviation, not drift.

decisions.decision: A confirmed odometer replacement writes the reading like any other; refineAvgDailyKm's km < 0 guard handles it (P3-D-12)
decisions.rationale: No new field (D-21), no new OdoSource value, no deletion, no special-case code. Carry-forward for Phase 6: the replacement leaves a large negative delta the offline recomputation must skip.

decisions.decision: The Cai dat tab ships as a real screen with 11's four groups in order, undelivered rows disabled (P3-D-13)
decisions.rationale: HOME-01 needs the three-tab shell now while all Settings content is Phase 4/5/6. The skeleton means those phases fill an existing slot instead of rebuilding the screen.

decisions.decision: The item-detail screen is read-first: status, history, and one button opening the log sheet pre-ticked (P3-D-14)
decisions.rationale: Holds the line at SET-02 (Phase 6) for interval editing and enable/disable, without forcing a trip back to home to record anything.

decisions.decision: Note attachment is exposed only in the reverse direction, from item detail (P3-D-15)
decisions.rationale: Attaching is the rare case; a picker would add two fields to a screen whose common use is one free line of text.

decisions.decision: All pinned notes render on home, below the item list (P3-D-16)
decisions.rationale: Pinning is a deliberate act; capping it defeats HOME-06's purpose of having the note in front of the user at the workshop, and the home screen scrolls.

decisions.decision: Receipt photos are out of Phase 3, recorded as BL-03 in BACKLOG.md (P3-D-17)
decisions.rationale: No Phase 3 requirement covers photo capture. Adding it pulls in camera permission, picker, viewer and delete path -- the scope-creep shape D-34 and 13.2 exist to stop.

decisions.decision: BACKLOG item BL-01 is folded into Phase 3 and done before the new state entry points are written (P3-D-18)
decisions.rationale: lib/state/app_state.dart imports OnboardingDraft from lib/ui/onboarding/; addServiceLog and the ODO-04 path are about to add two more entry points. Doing it first means new code is written against the correct dependency direction instead of copying the inversion.

context_notes: The discussion was grounded in reading the actual code rather than the source document alone, and that is where its value sits. Three findings drove four of the eighteen decisions and a resuming agent should not have to rediscover them: (1) computeDue's isEstimate at lib/domain/due.dart:174 ORs two different causes together, which HOME-05 needs separated; (2) 5.2's addServiceLog never touches Vehicle, so the source as written leaves the home screen contradicting a log the user just saved; (3) completeOnboarding writes no OdoReading at all, so OdoSource.setup is a dead enum value and the first ODO update has no previous reading to measure against. Decisions are namespaced P3-D-01..P3-D-18 following the P1-D/P2-D convention. No blocking anti-pattern was discovered this session; the two standing ones (the decision-coverage parser namespace mismatch and the Bash-heredoc backslash corruption) are carried forward as advisory, both already documented in STATE.md and CLAUDE.md.
